title: VoiceCallList - Data API
description: Represents a prioritized list of numbers to call.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Whether the call list is active or not.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the call list.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the call list owner.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **VoiceCallListOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **VoiceCallListShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
